verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere documents a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1.0 document for its hosted Wally inference API at /api-reference/openapi.json. It is advertised in llms.txt, pins its source schemas by sha256, and drives the docs' Try-it playground. The probe 404s were on different candidate paths, so they do not contradict this location. Missing for 10: independent or probe confirmation that the /api-reference/openapi.json file is actually retrievable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
